title: JSONL detection accepts action events that parsing silently discards
reasoning: Format detection accepts an event containing action without is_step, but processing immediately drops every event without a truthy is_step. A directory containing action-only JSONL events therefore passes can_parse and returns an empty trajectory without an error.
reproduction: Use an events.jsonl containing {"action":"run","args":{"command":"pwd"}}. can_parse returns true, while parse produces no steps.
recommendation: Make detection and processing share an explicit event contract, including processing supported action events when is_step is absent.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included that verify detection and parsing agree for accepted JSONL event forms.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise supported action events with and without is_step and verify that accepted actionable events produce their corresponding trajectory steps.
minimumFixScope: OpenHandsParser JSONL detection and event processing.
